name: TraceSignals Conversion Tracking
author: tracesignals

sections.description:
TraceSignals makes marketing tracking effortless for eCommerce stores. Track conversions, integrate GA4, Google Ads, and Facebook Pixel in minutes.

🚀 One-Click Setup
Enter your Measurement ID or Pixel ID, save, and you’re done. No coding required.

🧠 Multi-Pixel Support
Simultaneously track analytics and specialized measurement pixel events.

📊 eCommerce Event Tracking
* Product page views
* Add to cart events
* Checkout initiated
* Purchase conversions with revenue

✅ CMS Compliant
* No external dependencies
* Follows standard coding practices
* Secure (nonce verification, sanitization, escaping)
* Translation ready

🎯 Perfect For
* Store owners who want simple analytics setup
* Marketers who need accurate conversion attribution

External services

This plugin connects to external analytics services (Google Analytics and Meta/Facebook Pixel) to track user interactions and conversions on your site.

Depending on your configuration, it will send page views, product interactions, and eCommerce purchase data (including order totals and product IDs) to these services when users browse your storefront. This is required to provide conversion attribution and remarketing capabilities.

  • Google Analytics / Google Ads: Data is sent directly to Google’s servers. Google Terms of Service | Google Privacy Policy
  • Meta (Facebook) Pixel: Data is sent directly to Meta’s servers. Meta Terms of Service | Meta Privacy Policy

Support

For support, visit our website or email our support team.

Privacy Policy

This plugin sends data to your configured analytics provider. Review their privacy policy for details on data handling.

The plugin does NOT store personal data in your local database. All tracking happens client-side via your chosen analytics platform.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tracesignals-conversion-tracking folder to your plugins directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to TraceSignals in the admin sidebar
  4. Enter your Measurement ID
  5. Check the enable box and click Save
sections.faq:
Do I need an analytics account?

Yes. You should have an account with a supported analytics provider.

Is this privacy compliant?

The plugin uses standard data anonymization by default. You are responsible for managing user consent according to your local regulations.

Does this slow down my site?

No. The tracking scripts load asynchronously and are extremely lightweight.
